## Parental OpControl 0.17.13

- Fixed the Luna chat back button and other top-left controls: the invisible moon layer no longer sits over the open chat and swallows clicks.
- The back button, theme button, "..." menu, Close, resize grip, avatar button and home tiles now respond across their whole visible area at 100%, 125%, 150% and 200% scaling, in both themes.
- This release is offered to all devices through the normal catalog.
